notable.name: Coptic
notable.note: liturgical language of the Coptic Christian minority, written in the Coptic script (derived from Greek); not used in everyday signage

language.note: Egyptian Arabic is the most widely understood Arabic dialect across the Arab world due to Egypt's historical dominance in film/TV/media

terrainDescription.zh: 國土約九成五為撒哈拉沙漠，尼羅河谷與三角洲雖僅占國土一小部分，卻集中了絕大多數人口與高度密集的農業／都市帶。
terrainDescription.en: About 95% of the country is Sahara desert; the Nile valley and delta occupy only a small fraction of the land area but hold the vast majority of the population in a dense agricultural and urban corridor.

historicalContext.zh: 現代標準阿拉伯語為官方語言，但埃及阿拉伯方言因埃及長期為阿拉伯世界影視媒體中心，成為全阿拉伯世界理解度最高的方言；科普特語僅作為科普特基督徒的禮拜用語，以源自希臘字母的科普特文書寫，日常路牌招牌並不使用。
historicalContext.en: Modern Standard Arabic is the official language, but Egyptian Arabic is the most widely understood dialect across the Arab world, a legacy of Egypt's long dominance in Arabic-language film and television. Coptic survives only as a liturgical language among Coptic Christians, written in the Greek-derived Coptic script — it does not appear on everyday signage.
